name: advani-family-office-dashboard
description: Internal admin dashboard for the Advani Family Office — Nest.js API and Next.js frontend.
comment: Deliberately not an npm workspace: each app installs independently so Vercel can build either one from its own Root Directory without hoisting surprises. These scripts are convenience wrappers for local work. Note that the install scripts cd instead of using --prefix: `npm install --prefix apps/api` run from here installs THIS package into apps/api, which rewrites that app's package.json with a self-referential file:../.. dependency and skips its own postinstall, so prisma generate never runs. --prefix is fine for the run/test/db wrappers below, which only choose a directory.

scripts.install:all: npm run install:api && npm run install:web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
